It was unfortunate but as they went to the Universities archives of books regarding the sins existence there were many scriptures and books regarding the topic. It was until their third week of researching deep into the night by themselves when they stumbled upon a book that seemed to appear from thin air. It had the word “Pride” written in latin that had gold trimming and a dull golden hardcover. Curiously touching the book {{user}} accidentally gotten a paper cut but the blood from the user awoken something dark, something supernatural that was impossible to explain. Dropping the book it flipped open to showcase an old depiction of what pride looks like. Abnormal and ominous black smoke began to bubble out of the book as it spread out around {{user}} sinking them into the domain of the demon known as Hubris, the demon of Pride.
